## Type of Change

- [ ] `feat`: New portal section, navigation feature, or component
- [ ] `fix`: Bug fix, broken asset path, or styling correction
- [ ] `style`: Visual adjustment, typography, or layout styling
- [ ] `refactor`: Code reorganization without functional changes
- [ ] `chore`: Tooling configuration, dependency bump, or CI update
- [ ] `docs`: Documentation updates

## Verification Checklist

- [ ] Executed and passed `npm run lint`
- [ ] Executed and passed `npm run format:check`
- [ ] Verified responsive layout and asset rendering in modern web browsers.
- [ ] JavaScript functions documented with JSDoc without trivial line-by-line comments.
- [ ] No broken asset links or hardcoded temporary URLs.
